images.title: Sixths that fill a half
images.purpose: Show that 3 pieces of 1/6 laid end to end are exactly as long as 1/2 of the same chikki bar.
images.composition: Two long flat chikki bars of the same length, one above the other with a wide gap, and one sentence centred below.
images.exact_structure: Upper bar: a plain flat rectangle cut into 2 equal pieces, the left piece filled teal #0072B2, the right piece plain. Lower bar: exactly the same length, left edges lined up, cut into 6 equal pieces, the left 3 pieces filled amber #E69F00, the other 3 plain. The end of the teal half lines up exactly with the end of the third amber piece. Small numbers are not drawn on the pieces. Exactly 2 bars, 2 halves, 6 sixths, 3 amber pieces.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
bars of different lengths, nuts or texture drawn on the chikki, or unequal pieces
images.takeaway: 3 pieces of 1/6 fill the length of 1/2.
images.description: Two chikki bars of the same length, one cut in halves with the left half teal, one cut in sixths with the first three sixths amber; the teal half and the three amber sixths end together.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to count the amber pieces under the teal half aloud: one, two, three.

image_decisions.why: Counting smaller pieces that fit on a larger piece is a picture idea; one image of two bars carries it.
